title: Steve Lewis joins the band
summary: Steve Lewis traveled with Billy Mack's show before joining Bocage's band, was self-taught, could not read but had a wonderful ear.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah. When did you first meet Steve Lewis?

Well Steve, he used to go on, he traveled with a show called Billy Mack, you know. And we had another boy playing with us called Arthur Campbell. Well Arthur left me, he went to Chicago, see. Well Steve came in town and he come out and started playing with us. Well in Carroll family. Yeah, he stayed with us, yeah. But he used to travel with Billy Mack's show to play these theaters, you know, circuits, like the Lyric and there was different places, you know, around Chicago and Cleveland and things like that to play them little shows, you know.
Who taught Steve to play? Steve?
I don't know who taught Steve. No, not Steve, Steve.
Steve Lewis. He taught himself. Did he?

Yeah, he taught himself. He used good piano players, yeah. Couldn't read though, you know. Couldn't read, Steve Lewis. He had a wonderful ear, you know, gifted, you know. If we played a stock, well we had all good men, you know. And we played down once, he had it, you know. He knew all the chords and everything, you see.
